source_quality_warnings: JICA Tables 3.6-1 and 3.6-2 list incompatible AW2 capacities (1,030 vs 1,026); retain both and do not silently reconcile.
AW4 332.4 tonnes is a structural dynamic load designation (AW3 plus 0.25g), not a valid real train mass for F=ma.
The speed regulations in JICA Table 3.1-2 are historical design/operating-rule references, not verified 2026 on-track restrictions.
LRTA station-to-station distance should not be represented as surveyed chainage from opposing stopping marks.
Successful FOI requests are leads to attachments, not proof of numerical contents before download and inspection.
Data on modern refurbished or replacement trains must not be mixed with original Toshiba/Hyundai Rotem configuration without configuration management.
